title: All body exercise
author: Kaj Maseland
desc:
The program exists of power sets, to quickly perform the program. It fits for people who have little time for training but do want to cover the basics. 

You can make the program into something your own, if you want to cover some muscles more. 

For example change the push up or pull up variation. 
Or do a cable row instead of rows with an elastic

ex.note:
Run around and do some jumping jacks, to warm up the muscles, before exercise. You do not want to be the one tearing a muscle right?!

Go for it and do them for 1,5 minutes

ss.note:
Based on your level, you can do this exercise with weight or with elastics. 

If you dont have a place to do them in neutral grip, a standard pull up will be fine

Place two stable objects under your hands. It increases the stretch in your chest. 

When you are nearly at failure, continue with doing knee pushups.
One of the mentally more challenging exercises. Bite through the pain and imbalance, but stay save.

1. Put an elastic around an object
2. Sit in front of the object and start pulling the elastic to your belly button

You might change this exercise with other variations for the mid-back

If you have the opportunity to do Dips, do those sometimes aswell. 

To fatigue the chest muscle, switch to knee pushups in the end
If all is well, your back feels sour, but can still do some reps
If you cant do them, try different variations. It will work your core

Go for it and do them for 1,5 minutes

ss.note:
Based on your level, you can do this exercise with weight or with elastics. 

If you dont have a place to do them in neutral grip, a standard pull up will be fine

Place two stable objects under your hands. It increases the stretch in your chest. 

When you are nearly at failure, continue with doing knee pushups.
One of the mentally more challenging exercises. Bite through the pain and imbalance, but stay save.

1. Put an elastic around an object
2. Sit in front of the object and start pulling the elastic to your belly button

You might change this exercise with other variations for the mid-back

If you have the opportunity to do Dips, do those sometimes aswell. 

To fatigue the chest muscle, switch to knee pushups in the end
If all is well, your back feels sour, but can still do some reps
If you cant do them, try different variations. It will work your core
